author: SaswordC
body: Auriga makes your summons stronger while making you weaker (the summons dealt dmg while you stay alive and support them), hydrus is the opposite (you would be dealing dmg). Base summoner is 50/50, you could do either things but not as strong as a celestial class.

author: SnooDoodles5716
body: I would suggest you to switch to beo auriga, from my personal experiance it was best thing ive done. So far i got 5 plus levels while having fun and exploring tier 10 content. Now im dishing 4mln dmg per move while having almost no gear.
